_about: Stage 1 cases for the question-generating reviewer (`services/bullet_review_v2.py`). Nothing here passes or fails: `run_review_eval.py` is the pass/fail check on the production contract, and this one exists to be read. Each case supplies its own four-field fit context with requirement ids, so `requirement_reference` is exercised — including a case whose only match is inferred, and cases where the tempting reference is a resume-wide gap the question must not touch. `expect` is a note to the reader about what a good answer looks like, not an assertion.
